about: Shah Metacorp Ltd, formerly Gyscoal Alloys Ltd, manufactures stainless-steel long products at Mehsana, Gujarat. Its range includes ingots, angles, flats, round/bright bars and metal-processing job work. The consolidated group also has agro and commodity- trading businesses. [1]
